restrictions: Messages are uniformly random 64-byte strings A||B; every evaluation is one complete single-block hash = one target compression or permutation.
Fixed work: q = 2^128 trials, 4-pass 64-bit-digit LSD radix sort, one scan; 144 charged word operations per trial at 1/C, C = 1626.
Success >= 0.3934 is proved for the fixed target via Schur-concavity of the birthday probability (Munford 1977); no randomness heuristic.
Memory 2^135.585 bytes (two record arrays and the counter array); reported, not scored.
